status: Design only; no scientific execution or adoption authorized by this packet.
question: At a useful paid shared-parameter storage/serving point, does a bounded centered edge-factor bank improve pooled node-classification accuracy over an ordinary shared-factor bank without lowering its mean member accuracy?

fixed_representative_design.site: First common-input propagation interface only; retain native residual/root paths and existing private feature factors.
fixed_representative_design.backbone: Competent admitted source-native fixed-P backbone, e.g. GCNII. Shared dense backbone remains learnable.
fixed_representative_design.gate: One shared learned feature generator on the identical public X given to controls, tanh outputs. No label/node-ID lookup.
fixed_representative_design.coefficient_init: Nonzero bounded centered patterns, e.g. rho/4 times [[1,1],[-1,1],[1,-1],[-1,-1]].
fixed_representative_design.constraint: Column centering plus common row-L1 scale; fixed P normalization retained.
fixed_representative_design.training: Ordinary member-supervised TRAIN acquisition/continuation; all dense/private/gate parameters learn; no new diversity penalty or strength grid.
fixed_representative_design.serving: All members execute; uniform class-probability mean.

comparators: Same bounded feature gate bank allowing a learned common coefficient component: isolates value/possible cost of fixed mean operator.
Capable same-information learned-gate single; native strong Polynormer/GCNII/H2GCN controls using identical X and admitted roles.
Same-operation untied four if claiming a sharing quality/storage tradeoff; all work paid.
Constant-node-gate or equivalent propagation-gain comparison if making a structural association interpretation.
avoid_duplicate: Compiled four-trajectory single with identical probability mean is an algebraic renaming and is not fitted twice.
selection: Freeze ordinary roles/schedule/selection and confirmation before execution through root; no current VALID/TEST reopening authorized.
success_requirement: Pooled accuracy improves against ordinary bank at fully charged operating point.
Mean member accuracy at least matches ordinary bank.
Balance benefit requires improvement over the mean-coefficient-enabled bank; otherwise credit known unconstrained adaptation.
Stronger same-information single/strong controls do not explain away the asserted bank benefit.
falsifiers: No accuracy gain, even with lower NLL or greater disagreement.
Effect reproduced by a capable same-context single or pure propagation-gain changes.
Added paid training/serving/memory defeats claimed practical tradeoff.
Unbalanced graph adaptation wins: no balancing advantage established.
novelty: Known-family utility hypothesis only; no new conditional-message, latent-adjacency, low-rank-operator or antithetic-ensemble novelty.
